bio: Mitchell Alan Berman (born February 7, 1986) is an American politician and registered nurse from Racine County, Wisconsin. A member of the Democratic Party, he is a member-elect of the U.S. House of Representatives, and will represent Wisconsin's 1st congressional district in the 120th Congress (2027–2029). He will be the first Democrat to represent this district since 1994.
